272-294 DU ;; Decision table summarising api.md HTTP semantics (owner constraints in api.md) and the status-code sections above (captured as x.http-* constraints).

C api004.empty-collection-ref OL API-004 DEFAULT ;; An empty collection is a successful result: 200 with [] rather than 204 or 404. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.http-201-location EX API-003 DEFAULT ;; Include a Location header identifying a created resource when a stable resource URI exists. ;; = ;; Stable resource URI exists. ;; Location-header obligation not in the oracle.
C api003.201-resource-created OL API-003 MUST ;; PUT may return 201 when it creates a resource at a new URI; the test is whether the HTTP operation created a new API resource. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api003.202-incomplete OL API-003 MUST ;; 202 is for accepted but incomplete processing (long-running, background, async, queued). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.http-202-operation EX API-003 DEFAULT ;; When practical return an operation identifier or Location to observe progress for 202 responses. ;; = ;; When practical. ;; Operation-tracking response shape not in the oracle.
C api003.204-no-body OL API-003 MUST ;; 204 is for successful operations with no response body (e.g. DELETE, updates where the representation adds no value). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.http-304 EX API-003 MUST ;; Use 304 only for conditional requests whose cached representation is still valid; never as a generic 'nothing changed' business response. ;; = ;; none ;; Less-common status semantics outside the oracle (EXC-009).
C api005.401-not-400 OL API-005 MUST_NOT ;; 400 is for invalid HTTP requests (malformed, binding, contract-uninterpretable), not for authentication failure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api005.401-meaning OL API-005 MUST ;; 401 means authentication is missing or failed (no credentials, invalid/expired token, challenge). ;; = ;; none ;;
C api005.403-meaning OL API-005 MUST ;; 403 means authentication succeeded but the principal may not perform the operation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api004.404-vs-empty OL API-004,API-005 MUST ;; 404 when the addressed resource does not exist or is deliberately hidden; collection queries with zero matches return 200 []. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.http-406-415 EX API-003 MUST ;; 406 when no acceptable response representation can be produced; 415 when the request body media type is unsupported; do not confuse them. ;; = ;; none ;; Content-negotiation status semantics outside the oracle (EXC-009).
C api006.409-cases OL API-006 MUST ;; 409 for uniqueness duplicates, incompatible state transitions, conflicting concurrent operations or reused idempotency keys with different payloads; not for malformed syntax. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api006.412-precondition OL API-006 MUST ;; A false client precondition (e.g. stale If-Match) is normally 412, not a generic 409. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.http-422 EX API-003,API-002 DEFAULT ;; Use 422 for structurally valid requests with invalid semantics/business content; follow an established project convention when 400 is used for both; new APIs that distinguish use 400 for contract errors and 422 for semantic errors. ;; = ;; Established project convention of 400 for both. ;; 400/422 distinction is not in the oracle.
C x.http-428 EX API-006 MUST ;; Use 428 when a contract-required precondition (e.g. If-Match) is absent; for other mandatory preconditions only when the contract explicitly defines them. ;; = ;; none ;; 428 semantics outside the oracle (API-006 covers 409/412 only).
C api007.500-central OL API-007,API-002,API-008 MUST ;; 500 is for unexpected failures with no more specific controlled outcome, produced via centralized exception handling and ProblemDetails without internal details. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.http-502-504 EX API-003 MUST_NOT ;; 502/504 only when this API acts as an intermediary receiving an invalid upstream response or upstream timeout; do not map every dependency failure to 502 or every TaskCanceledException to 504; distinguish own timeouts from upstream timeouts. ;; = ;; none ;; Gateway status semantics outside the oracle (EXC-009).
C x.http-503 EX API-003 DEFAULT ;; 503 for temporary inability (maintenance, critical dependency unavailable, chosen overload semantics) with Retry-After when a meaningful time is known. ;; = ;; none ;; 503 semantics outside the oracle.
C api021.distinguish-cancel OL API-021 MUST ;; Distinguish a client-cancelled request from timeouts when choosing a response. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.no-false-idempotency OL RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not claim idempotency merely because duplicate requests are unlikely. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api006.conditional-requests OL API-006 PREFER ;; When HTTP optimistic concurrency is part of the contract prefer standard conditional request semantics (ETag/If-Match/412) over custom status codes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc010.translate-outcomes OL ARC-010 MUST ;; Controllers translate Application outcomes into HTTP outcomes. ;; = ;; none ;;
